digest.component_or_area: ticket state model and write surfaces
propositions: Add two new ticket state fields, bridge_project (tri-state string) and repos (list of strings), to the schema and reducer with projection from CREATE and EDIT events.
Create-time arguments --bridge-project and --repos must be accepted and processed identically across all three write surfaces: CLI, library API, and MCP.
bridge_project must be promote-only on the edit path: setting it on an unbound ticket succeeds, but editing it on a ticket with an existing binding must fail with non-zero exit and no state change.
The tri-state bridge_project field must remain distinguishable after replay: absent (legacy), explicit empty string (never sync), and a key value (sync to project).
Tickets created before this change must replay to identical state apart from the new fields being absent.
Edit surface must include both bridge_project and repos with a promote-only guard that consults bindings.json to determine binding status.
